text.p: These are the leading stories in the Tunisian press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- President Ben Ali received a message from participants in Arab sociologists meeting held in the Tunisian resort of Hammamet for his great support to researchers and intellectuals.
- 25 countries take part in the international symposium of architects to be held in Tunis on May 19-24.
- Good performance by tourism in the Tunisian resort of Sousse. Nights rose 11.1 percent during the first four months of 1997 compared with the same period of 1996.
